title: U.S. Army Soldiers Participate in Hoist Operations During Guardian Response 22
description: 1st Lt. Molly Shepard, assigned to the 2-3 General Support Aviation Battalion, shares her training experience during Guardian Response at Muscatatuck Urban Training Center, Indiana. Guardian Response 22 is a homeland emergency response exercise designed to sharpen skills, boost capabilities and improve mission readiness during a disaster. (Video by U.S. Army Spc. Caroline Sauder)
keywords: Guardian Response 22, National Guard, army, Army Reserve, USAR, Muscatatuck Urban Training Center
